tagline: Grown down the lane, baked this morning
intro: A family farm shop and café near Ledbury selling our own fruit, vegetables, cider and bread, with breakfast served until noon.
about_title: The same family, the same fields, since 1921
about:
The Pembertons have grown apples at Orchard Lane for more than a hundred years. The shop began as a table at the gate with an honesty box. The table is still there, in the corner by the till.

Today we sell what we grow, what our neighbours make and what Nan bakes. If it has travelled more than thirty miles to reach the shelf, we have had a long argument about it.

services.name: The farm shop
services.description: Our own fruit and vegetables, local meat, cheese, eggs and store-cupboard things.

services.name: The café
services.description: Breakfast until noon, soup and pies at lunch, and cake all afternoon.

services.name: Pick your own
services.description: Strawberries from June, plums in August and apples through to October.

services.name: Cider and juice
services.description: Pressed on the farm from our own apples. Tastings every Saturday.

services.name: Veg boxes
services.description: A weekly box of what is ready, delivered within ten miles on Thursdays.

services.name: Christmas orders
services.description: Turkeys, trees, wreaths and hampers to order from November.

values.title: We grow it
values.text: Most of the fruit and vegetables come from fields you can see from the car park.

values.title: Thirty-mile rule
values.text: What we do not grow comes from farms and makers nearby.

values.title: Nothing wasted
values.text: Wonky fruit becomes juice, jam and Tuesday's crumble.

process.title: Spring
process.text: Blossom in the orchard, asparagus and the first rhubarb in the shop.

process.title: Summer
process.text: Pick-your-own strawberries, salad from the tunnels and suppers outside.

process.title: Autumn
process.text: Apple harvest, cider pressing and pumpkins in the top field.

process.title: Winter
process.text: Christmas trees, wreath making and proper soup in the café.

faq.a: Yes. Dogs on leads are welcome in the shop, the café garden and the orchard walk.

faq.q: Do I need to book the café?
faq.a: Not on weekdays. We recommend booking for weekend breakfast and Sunday lunch.
From early June to late October, depending on the weather. Check our opening times before you travel.
Veg boxes and Christmas orders are delivered within ten miles every Thursday.

projects.title: Blossom week

projects.details: Paths are mown through the oldest trees for two weeks in late April.

projects.title: Strawberry season
projects.summary: Six weeks of pick-your-own, weather allowing.
projects.details: Bring a basket or borrow one. Under-fives pick free.

projects.title: Pressing day
projects.summary: Watch the press at work and taste the first juice.
projects.details: Every Saturday in October, with the family on hand to explain how it is done.

projects.title: Wreath workshops
projects.summary: Make your own from holly, ivy and orchard prunings.
projects.details: Two hours with mulled juice and mince pies. Book early.
